turns.ask: We run an online store in Southeast Asia with about 30,000 daily users and big sales peaks. Design a highly available web architecture.

ops.text: I'll design a highly available online store in Singapore with ESA, ALB, WAF, auto-scaling ECS, Tair and PolarDB.
30,000 daily users with big sales peaks
Store runs in Singapore for Southeast Asia shoppers
Public-facing storefront

ops.label: Shoppers
ops.why: 30k daily users browsing the store.

ops.label: Cloud DNS
ops.why: Resolves the store domain to ESA.

ops.label: ESA
ops.why: Caches pages and absorbs sale-day spikes near Southeast Asian shoppers.

ops.label: ALB
ops.why: Spreads shopper traffic across two zones.

ops.label: WAF
ops.why: Blocks bots and injection attacks during sales.

ops.label: Store app servers
ops.why: Runs the storefront in two zones.

ops.label: Auto Scaling
ops.why: Adds servers ahead of and during sales peaks.

ops.text: Carts go to Tair; orders go to PolarDB, which adds read nodes fast for peaks.

ops.label: Cart and session cache
ops.why: Keeps carts and hot product data fast under load.

ops.label: Orders DB
ops.why: Scales reads instantly for sales with zone failover.

ops.label: NAT Gateway
ops.why: Outbound access to payment and shipping APIs.

ops.label: Product images
ops.why: Stores images that ESA serves from cache.

ops.label: Logs
ops.why: Central logs and alerts during peaks.

ops.text: Do you need disaster recovery in a second region, or is two-zone HA in Singapore enough?

ops.summary: Two-zone store in Singapore: ESA, ALB with WAF, auto-scaling ECS, Tair, PolarDB, OSS and SLS.

turns.ask: Our e-commerce site suffers from bot sign-ups, credential stuffing and occasional DDoS attacks. Protect it.

ops.text: I'll draw a security layer for your e-commerce site: ESA for DDoS and edge WAF, plus Captcha and Fraud Detection for sign-ups.
App already runs on ECS behind an ALB
Site is hosted in Singapore

ops.label: Shoppers and bots
ops.why: Visitors reaching the e-commerce site.

ops.label: Cloud DNS
ops.why: Resolves shop domain to ESA.

ops.label: ESA
ops.why: Absorbs DDoS attacks and accelerates traffic at the edge.

ops.label: ALB
ops.why: Load balancer for the web tier.

ops.label: WAF 3.0
ops.why: Blocks credential stuffing and OWASP attacks at the ALB.

ops.label: Web servers
ops.why: Runs the e-commerce application.

ops.label: Anti-DDoS Native
ops.why: Scrubbing for direct IP attacks bypassing ESA.

ops.text: Captcha challenges bots at sign-up and login; Fraud Detection scores risky registrations.

ops.label: Captcha 2.0
ops.why: Challenges bots on sign-up and login forms.

ops.label: Fraud Detection
ops.why: Scores sign-ups and logins to stop fake accounts and takeovers.

ops.text: How large are the DDoS attacks you see?
